findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "check_voucher_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "bazaar_pay_and_call" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "loyalty-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mint_loyalty_tokens, bazaar_discover_resources, bazaar_probe_x402 · Private data: create_loyalty_program, register_loyalty_program, update_program_status, create_reward, mint_loyalty_tokens, transfer_loyalty_tokens, earn_points, get_token_balance, list_marketplace_offers, redeem_reward, check_voucher_status, get_platform_stats, export_customers, create_gift_certificate, bazaar_pay_and_call · Public sink: mint_loyalty_tokens, earn_points, confirm_mint_fee, send_report · Destructive: delete_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mint_loyalty_tokens, bazaar_discover_resources, bazaar_probe_x402 · Private data: create_loyalty_program, register_loyalty_program, update_program_status, create_reward, mint_loyalty_tokens, transfer_loyalty_tokens, earn_points, get_token_balance, list_marketplace_offers, redeem_reward, check_voucher_status, get_platform_stats, export_customers, create_gift_certificate, bazaar_pay_and_call · Public sink: mint_loyalty_tokens, earn_points, confirm_mint_fee, send_report · Destructive: delete_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
